notes.title: New Languages and Season 3 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I’m happy to share that the game now supports additional languages: [b]Turkish, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Greek.[/b][/p][p]These translations were created by passionate members of the community, so minor inaccuracies may occur. Huge thanks to everyone who helped. If you spot an issue, please let us know in the Steam discussions or on our Discord.[/p][p]Season 3 is in active development and is planned to be about as large as the first two seasons combined. It will finally bring key storylines to a conclusion. A playable demo is coming soon, so stay tuned for updates.[/p]

notes.title: Translations update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[list]
[*] Fully updated translations - the game supports all stated languages, so you can comfortably immerse yourself in the story.
[*] Fixed identified bugs, so the passage became more stable.
[/list]

If you notice new bugs, write in [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/8VGFxAZJS6]Discord [/url][/b]or in comments - I will check and fix everything promptly.

Thanks for your support and have a nice game!

notes.title: Fresh Story 2 - Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!!!

[b]A new update is finally ready[/b]

Today I'm sharing fresh content that expands the relationship branches:  
- [b]MC × Kira and Liam[/b] - additional scenes have been added to vividly show their “chemistry”.  
- [b]MC × Paul[/b] - you'll learn more about Paul's past and see him getting closer to MC.

[b]Localizations[/b].
- The new content is now available in [b]Russian and English[/b].  
- Translations for the other languages are already in the works and will be [b]ready by the end of the month[/b]. At the same time we will fix all the bugs found when playing in other languages.

[b]Plot changes[/b].  
The branch with Jimmy and his “one-year contract” is temporarily cut. We want to reveal it more deeply, so we'll move the events to a more logical moment.

[b]Looking Forward: Season Three[/b]  
In parallel, we are hard at work on the [b]demo of the third season[/b]. The format is changing a bit: we're moving away from a purely “visual novel” format and adding interactivity to make the narrative more dynamic and understandable. Details and a demo are coming soon!


Thank you for your support and patience. It is you who help the project to grow and develop. See you in the third season!

Subscribe to our discord - [url=https://discord.com/invite/8VGFxAZJS6]Discord[/url]

notes.title: New languages are here! Brazilian, Portuguese, Spanish and Chinese!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear ones! 

We are happy to share the happy news - we have fulfilled our promise and added the long-awaited languages:

[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Portuguese
[*] Spanish
[*] Chinese
[/list]

Thank you so much for your patience and support while working on this. We understand how important it is for you to have access to content in your native language, and we sincerely appreciate your trust.

What's next?

In order to avoid such delays, we are changing our approach: from now on we will add new languages as part of major updates. Your wishes are our priority!

If you notice any inaccuracies or want to suggest something - write in comments or in Discord. It will help us to become better!

Thank you for being with us.

notes.title: Fresh Story Update: French Language Added!
notes.content:
Great news for all Fresh Story fans! The game now features a French language option, thanks to the amazing efforts of our passionate player and enthusiast, [b]kedom[/b].  We’re incredibly grateful for this contribution and excited to make our story accessible to an even wider audience.
[u][b]
What about other languages?[/b][/u]
The promised translations are in the hands of professional translators and are expected to be ready by January. Stay tuned for updates!

Thank you for your support, patience, and inspiration. We’re working hard to make your gaming experience as vivid and inclusive as possible! 

With love,
The Fresh Story Team

notes.title: Update: fixes and plans
notes.content:
After the update was published, a lot of bugs and errors were discovered. I've tried to fix everything for the moment, but it's possible that something might have gone unnoticed. I am testing alone, so I may have missed some issues. If you encounter any problems, please post them in comments, discussions, or Discord.  

Fixes:  
- Fixed bugs with incorrect day skipping.  
- Many players mistook the time skip on day 56 as a bug. This is actually part of the storyline. It will now display a message that time has passed at this point.  
- If any days are skipped, it means you are going down a different line and events that could have happened to the heroine are left out.  

In the future, I may revisit the system with days, as it caused confusion for some players.  

Also added a survey at the end of the game, if it's not too hard, please take it. It will help me out. 

Plans:  
There is a new update planned for February with more content that will close some story holes. 

This is not the end of the story - the final third season is ahead of you.  

When creating it, I will take into account all the mistakes I made when releasing the first and second seasons.  

I try to fix mistakes as quickly as possible and apologize for any inconvenience. Thank you for playing.

notes.title: bug fixes Fresh Story 2 - 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we are still actively working on improving your game version. Here is the list of fixes that have already been made:

[list]
[*] Correct display of character name in the English version. Now, your selected name will be displayed correctly throughout the game.
[*] Fixed errors with missing images (e.g. “Image ‘19035’ not found”).
[*] Corrected the path “Without Archie” so that all events in this branch develop logically and without failures.
[*] Restored the correspondence module in the phone - now the messages are displayed correctly.
[*] If the heroine becomes an online model, you will no longer miss a date because of it!
[/list]

 P.S. Sorry for any inconvenience these bugs may have caused, and thank you for reporting them! I read all your comments and try to fix things as soon as possible.

By the way, for those who choose the “No Archie” path, we have good news: the February update will be especially busy for this branch. There are tons of new events and content waiting for you.

Thank you for playing and supporting us!
